title: Where Are My Eyes
description: Replaces the one pixel eyes on the new baby mob textures with the eyes of the adult version.
body:
A simple resource pack that changes the new baby mob textures added in 26.1-snapshot-2 to have the eyes of their adult versions. Some of the new textures in the update look weird with the one pixel eyes, so I made a texture pack to change that.
Changed mobs (as of version 1):
- Cats
- Wolves
- Sheep
- Cow
- Mooshroom
